name: thin-undeclared-codex-marker
title: Undeclared codex usage from a pack-shipped doc blocks every conversion
description: The pack ships .claude/sd-ai-command-pack/planning-adversarial-review.md, which invokes the codex CLI. No consumer declares codex as a platform, so the thin resweep reports undeclared codex usage as a packDefect in every one of the eight consumers and no conversion can reach a clear verdict. Decide whether the doc declares codex, drops the invocation, moves to a machine surface, or the detector learns about optional lanes.
